Messages.Author: Markus Schlein
Messages.Body:
Hi,

Combat Situation:

Vamp A: Plays 3 sup. Horrid Form
Vamp B: Plays sup. Torn Signpost
Vamp A: Strikes with Kraken's Kiss for 4 Ranged
Vamp B: Hand Strike for 3
Vamp A: Prevents 3 with sup. Horrid Form

Question: Does Vamp A go to Torpor? Does he _take_ 3 damage or not?

Thanks for help,

-markus

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Markus Schlein wrote:
> Vamp A: Plays 3 sup. Horrid Form
> Vamp B: Plays sup. Torn Signpost
> Vamp A: Strikes with Kraken's Kiss for 4 Ranged
> Vamp B: Hand Strike for 3
> Vamp A: Prevents 3 with sup. Horrid Form
>
> Question: Does Vamp A go to Torpor? Does he _take_ 3 damage or not?

Not. It must be successfully inflicted.
